name: Avalon: The Riven Veil

categories.label: VP earned before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm đã ghi trước khi tính cuối game
categories.hint: Enter all VP earned from battles and game effects before final scoring.

categories.label: Final revealed settlement VP
categories.labelVi: Điểm khu định cư lật ngửa ở cuối game
categories.hint: Sum the VP printed in your revealed settlement slots scored at game end.

categories.label: Holy Grail holder (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Người giữ Chén Thánh (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Select only for the player holding the Holy Grail at game end.

categories.label: Printed VP value on Faction Board (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Giá trị VP in trên Bảng phe (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Enter the faction's printed VP value. Lower value wins a final VP tie after the Holy Grail holder.

tiebreakers.description: If tied on VP, the Holy Grail holder wins.
If still tied, the faction with the lowest printed VP value on its Faction Board wins.

notes: Retail core game only; Mist Walker and other expansion modules are excluded. Record all VP earned from battles and effects before final scoring, then add final revealed settlement VP once. No automated faction-specific or expansion scoring.
